description: Finding 4 (Medium) - Audit log integrity/retention. The hash chain is keyed with app.secret_key (shared root key, ephemeral when SECRET_KEY unset, so the chain is unverifiable after restart); verify_chain is never called outside tests; full PII (username, IP, User-Agent) is mirrored verbatim to stdout; retention is a docs placeholder. Fix (code-level fully; retention docs-only): dedicated IDP_AUDIT_CHAIN_KEY with fail-closed startup, invoke verify_chain at startup and on each audit-log render, redact the stdout mirror, and state concrete retention guidance. Ordered after FEAT-002 because the per-render verify banner attaches to the audit-log handler that FEAT-002 converts to POST. Do NOT externalize chain state (single-worker topology); just note the multi-worker caveat.
steps: In identity_provider_server/config.py add `"audit_chain_key": ""` to _DEFAULTS["security"]; add field `audit_chain_key: str = ""` to SecurityConfig; add `"IDP_AUDIT_CHAIN_KEY": ("security", "audit_chain_key")` to the env_map.

In identity_provider_server/app.py add an `audit_chain_key: str = ""` kwarg to create_app and a resolver that mirrors the WeakSecretKeyError fail-closed pattern (~line 899): if audit_chain_key (or IDP_AUDIT_CHAIN_KEY env) is set, use it; else establish a STABLE per-deployment key by reading or creating `data / 'audit_chain.key'` as a 0600 random file (secrets.token_hex(32)); the key must NOT reuse app.secret_key. Add an AuditChainKeyError (RuntimeError subclass) and raise it if a stable key cannot be established (e.g. the data dir is not writable) so auditing never silently runs on an ephemeral key.

In identity_provider_server/app.py change the AuditLogger construction (~line 1246) to pass the resolved dedicated chain key: `AuditLogger(data_dir, chain_key=<resolved_audit_chain_key>, failure_callback=_audit_write_failed)`.

In identity_provider_server/app.py, immediately after constructing the AuditLogger, call `audit.verify_chain()`; on False, log an error and fire the notify callback (reuse the _audit_write_failed/notify wiring at ~lines 1240-1251, e.g. notify.notify('audit_chain_invalid', ..., severity='critical')). Add a brief comment noting the multi-worker _seq/_last_hash caveat is out of scope (single-worker topology).

In identity_provider_server/admin.py, in the audit-log handler (the POST handler after FEAT-002), call `chain_ok = audit_logger.verify_chain() if audit_logger else True` and pass `chain_ok` to render_template_string; add an integrity-warning banner block to the ADMIN_AUDIT_LOG template shown when `not chain_ok`.

In identity_provider_server/audit.py redact the stdout mirror (~lines 180-187) only: build a separate dict/line for stdout where user_agent is replaced by a short sha256 hex (or omitted) and username is truncated (e.g. first 3 chars + '…' + length), while the on-disk JSON record and the hash chain remain byte-for-byte unchanged. Do not alter _compute_hash input or the on-disk payload.
Thread audit_chain_key from both entrypoints: in identity_provider_server/__main__.py and run_gunicorn.py add `audit_chain_key=config.security.audit_chain_key,` to the create_app(...) calls.

In docs/security.md replace the audit-log 'Per retention policy' placeholder (~line 17 data-inventory row) with concrete guidance: retain 12 months, keep the most recent 3 months immediately queryable; state that rotation and external append-only (WORM) forwarding are the operator's responsibility. In docs/configuration.md add an IDP_AUDIT_CHAIN_KEY row to the env-var table.

Add tests in a new tests/test_audit_integrity.py: (a) a provided IDP_AUDIT_CHAIN_KEY is used and the chain is independent of app.secret_key (two apps with same chain key but different secret_key verify each other's log; and a log keyed with the chain key does NOT verify under app.secret_key); (b) startup over a tampered audit.log triggers the notify/error path (patch notify); (c) the audit-log admin render shows the integrity banner when verify_chain is forced False; (d) the stdout mirror (capsys) omits/hashes the full User-Agent and truncates the username while the on-disk record retains full values. Add a @pytest.mark.smoke test for chain-key resolution + a clean verify_chain() happy path.
acceptance_criteria: Running `source /Users/topazb/python/py314/bin/activate && python -m pytest tests/test_audit_integrity.py tests/test_admin_full.py tests/test_security_remediation_20261003.py tests/test_config.py tests/test_remaining_coverage.py -q` passes.

The audit chain is keyed by IDP_AUDIT_CHAIN_KEY (or a stable data/audit_chain.key), never app.secret_key; verify_chain runs at startup (notify on failure) and on each audit-log render (banner on failure).
The stdout AUDIT mirror does not contain the full User-Agent or full username; the on-disk audit.log record is unchanged and still passes verify_chain.
docs/security.md states a concrete retention period; docs/configuration.md documents IDP_AUDIT_CHAIN_KEY.
ruff check identity_provider_server/ is clean and bandit -r identity_provider_server/ -q reports 0 medium/high.
verification: python -m pytest tests/test_audit_integrity.py tests/test_admin_full.py tests/test_security_remediation_20261003.py tests/test_config.py tests/test_remaining_coverage.py -q
findings:
IMPLEMENTED. Code changes:

- identity_provider_server/config.py: added `audit_chain_key: str = ""` to SecurityConfig, `"audit_chain_key": ""` (nosec B105) to _DEFAULTS["security"], and `"IDP_AUDIT_CHAIN_KEY": ("security", "audit_chain_key")` to the env_map; env-var docstring updated.

- identity_provider_server/app.py: added `AUDIT_CHAIN_KEY_FILENAME = "audit_chain.key"`, a new `AuditChainKeyError(RuntimeError)`, and `_resolve_audit_chain_key(audit_chain_key, data_dir)` (mirrors the WeakSecretKeyError fail-closed pattern): uses a supplied value / IDP_AUDIT_CHAIN_KEY verbatim, else reads/creates a stable 0600 `data/audit_chain.key` via secrets.token_hex(32); raises AuditChainKeyError on OSError so auditing never runs on an ephemeral key. Added `audit_chain_key: str = ""` kwarg to create_app (+docstring). The AuditLogger is now constructed with `chain_key=_resolve_audit_chain_key(audit_chain_key, data)` (NO longer app.secret_key). Immediately after construction, `audit.verify_chain()` runs; on False it logs an error and fires `notify.notify("audit_chain_invalid", ..., severity="critical")`. A comment notes the per-process _seq/_last_hash cursor and that externalising chain state for multi-worker is out of scope (single-worker topology).

- identity_provider_server/admin.py: the POST audit-log handler (admin_audit_log_post, the FEAT-002 handler) now computes `chain_ok = audit_logger.verify_chain() if audit_logger else True` and passes `chain_ok` to render_template_string; the ADMIN_AUDIT_LOG template gained a red integrity-warning banner block shown `{% if not chain_ok %}` (text contains 'integrity check FAILED'). Cache-Control no-store wrapper from FEAT-002 preserved.

- identity_provider_server/audit.py: added `_redact_username` (first 3 chars + '…(<len>)') and `_hash_user_agent` ('sha256:'+12 hex) helpers and `_USERNAME_PREFIX_LEN`. The stdout mirror now serialises a redacted copy of the payload (username truncated, user_agent hashed) as `mirror_line`; the on-disk JSON record and `_compute_hash` input are byte-for-byte unchanged.

- identity_provider_server/__main__.py and run_gunicorn.py: added `audit_chain_key=config.security.audit_chain_key,` to the create_app(...) calls.

- .gitignore: added `data/audit_chain.key`.

DOCS:
- docs/security.md: data-inventory audit-log row now reads '12 months; most recent 3 months immediately queryable' and notes the keyed hash chain; the 'Log protection and monitoring' section gained a concrete Retention paragraph (12 months, 3 months hot, operator owns rotation + external append-only/WORM forwarding) and a new 'Audit-log integrity' subsection (dedicated key resolution, startup + per-render verification, fail-closed, single-worker caveat).
- docs/configuration.md: added IDP_AUDIT_CHAIN_KEY to the env-var table, `audit_chain_key` to the config.yaml security schema, and `audit_chain.key` to the data-directory layout table.

TESTS: new tests/test_audit_integrity.py (10 tests) covering: chain-key resolution (explicit/env/stable-file persistence + 0600) and a @pytest.mark.smoke clean verify_chain happy path; AuditChainKeyError fail-closed on undeliverable key; chain independence from app.secret_key (two chain-keyed loggers verify, a secret-keyed logger does not); startup notify on a tampered log; per-render integrity banner shown when verify_chain is forced False and absent when clean; stdout mirror redaction (UA hashed, username truncated) with full on-disk values that still verify.

VERIFICATION (all pass): `pytest tests/test_audit_integrity.py tests/test_admin_full.py tests/test_security_remediation_20261003.py tests/test_config.py tests/test_remaining_coverage.py` = 190 passed; `ruff check identity_provider_server/` clean; `bandit -r identity_provider_server/ -q` = 0 medium / 0 high (13 pre-existing Low only); `pytest -m smoke` = 31 passed; full suite 680 passed, 28 skipped at 100% coverage (audit.py, app.py, admin.py, config.py, run_gunicorn.py all 100%). HARD BOUNDARY respected: no Finding 1 backup/restore code touched. CHANGELOG.md Unreleased 'Security (code review idp-2026-10-06)' subsection gained the F4 entry.
